PRE_FLIGHT.ACTIVE_PROMPT: First SHINOBU_67 block: role MODULAR_BASE_CONSTRUCTION_VALIDATOR. Later duplicate SHINOBU_67 blocks are ignored for this domain.
PRE_FLIGHT.BUILD_POLICY: No dotnet build launched during the current strict H-PHI preview recheck. Static scans and diff-check only, per user instruction.

TWENTY_TASK_RECONCILIATION.TASK: Archive/binary ledger checked. No live wfc_module_bounds.h8bin authority found. Added GenerateEmergencyMockBounds() to hydrate 16 emergency AABB rows into ConstructionBuilderBounds when Vault bounds are empty.

Construction terrain validation no longer uses Physics.OverlapBox/OverlapBoxNonAlloc. Scoped scan returns no matches in SHINOBU_67 construction files. Live preview locks and hydrates a Vault-backed ConstructionBuilderOccupancy fixed hash table and rejects occupied registered grid cells through AUP-local integer hash lookup.
New construction DTOs are field-only explicit structs. No get/set or get/private set properties in ModularBaseConstructionValidator.
All new construction DTOs are 32B or 64B explicit layouts. No Pack=1.

MockWorldSampler exists as partial 64B struct. It rejects Distance below terrain clearance. Random was rejected for rollback determinism; seed-driven ridge fields are present but default amplitude is zero for stable fallback.

BurstGridValidationJob checks occupancy, SDF distance, port alignment, bounds, finite input, and SIP warning through unmanaged DTOs. PlayerBuilder preview now resolves and locks ConstructionBuilderOccupancy, hydrates BaseModuleOccupancyDTO rows, and does fixed-table occupied-cell lookup. Caveat: authoritative graph-owner occupancy export is still external, so hydration still reads registered module transforms.

ConstructionSipBudgetDTO preflight exists. PlayerBuilder feeds total budget, added SIP estimate, and depth pressure fallback. Direct HullIntegrity ledger dependency was rejected because it creates assembly coupling.

ConstructionPreviewSignal is emitted after validator result and consumed by HectonBlueprintPreviewBatch for instanced green/red AABB preview. HectonBlueprintPreviewBatch now stores only VaultBufferHandle fields, resolves NativeArray views locally, and locks ConstructionPreviewWrite/Build/Matrices while the Burst matrix job owns pointers. This is an unmanaged construction-owned fallback lane, not the final Agent 09 BRG module-hash renderer.
LogisticsGraphSpliceJob emits int2 neighbor edges from port-aligned cells. It does not mutate Agent 13 graph directly because no stable incremental graph mutation API was exposed.

Production inventory deduction uses HabitatConstructionManager.HasBuildResources/ConsumeBuildResources with rollback. DebugDeployActiveBuildable now destroys spawned module if consume fails. MockCraftingRequestSignal was not promoted.
GlobalQualityWeight now curves through step(0.3,q) * smoothstep(0.3,1.0,q) and lerp(1,9,curve). Weight below 0.3 collapses to one center SDF probe; weight 1.0 reaches nine AABB probes.
DeconstructionConnectivityJob runs BFS over directed int2 edges and flags disconnected wings.

TryBuildRequestFromAup subtracts RootAUP from TargetAUP first, validates the local delta, then casts to float3 and snaps to int3 grid. The voxel SDF adapter now also subtracts floating-origin offset before float conversion by using ToRuntimePosition(double3) and TrySampleRuntimeSdfDensity.
Build commit emits canonical AcousticPingSignal ChannelMetalStress. Literal AcousticEchoTap import was rejected because multiple incompatible AcousticEchoTap contracts exist in sibling domains.
Build commit emits construction-owned FloraExclusionSignal with AUP center and AABB extents. Existing BaseModuleNavModifier remains immediate vegetation/terrain-hole bridge.
AllocateRequestScratch uses NativeArrayOptions.UninitializedMemory for ConstructionRequestDTO scratch.
ConstructionBuilderTelemetry Vault ring is 300 entries. PlayerBuilder writes validation telemetry every terrain validation. Non-finite state triggers Dump_SHINOBU_67.bin.
WFC Builder Tuner editor window exposes Grid Snap Size, Max Base Bounds, Terrain Clearance Margin and writes Vault tuning.
Span-based module_bounds.csv parser exists. Editor button loads bytes cold-path and parser writes StructuralBoundsDTO rows into ConstructionBuilderBounds Vault buffer.
SceneView gizmo draws local grid and red terrain rejection AABB from last validator result.

ConstructionRequestDTO.MATH: 24 + 12 + 4 + 4 + 20 = 64 bytes, exactly one L1 cache line.

STRUCT_LAYOUT_VERIFICATION.OTHER_DTOS: StructuralBoundsDTO=32B, ConstructionValidationSettingsDTO=32B, BaseModuleOccupancyDTO=32B, ConstructionSipBudgetDTO=32B, ConstructionValidationResultDTO=32B, ConstructionTelemetryEntry=64B, ConstructionPreviewSignal=96B, FloraExclusionSignal=80B, BlueprintPreviewInstance=64B.
STRUCT_LAYOUT_VERIFICATION.FALSE_SHARING: ConstructionTelemetryEntry is 64B. Jobs write Result[0] only; no parallel atomic counter sharing added in SHINOBU_67.

SCALABILITY_CURVE_EXPLANATION.CURVE: activeQuality = step(0.3, saturate(GlobalQualityWeight)); probeWeight = smoothstep(0.3, 1.0, saturate(GlobalQualityWeight)) * activeQuality; probeCount = ceil(lerp(1, 9, probeWeight)).
SCALABILITY_CURVE_EXPLANATION.LOW_WEIGHT_BELOW_0_3: Only center AABB/SDF probe runs. Corner checks collapse out. This buys frame stability during drag on throttled mobile hardware and accepts the prompt's slight low-tier clipping risk.
SCALABILITY_CURVE_EXPLANATION.MIDDLE_TO_HIGH: Probe count increases continuously through the curve. More corners are sampled without binary low/high mode flips.
SCALABILITY_CURVE_EXPLANATION.ULTRA_WEIGHT_1_0: Nine probes run: center plus AABB corners. Editor gizmos expose red rejection box for designer diagnosis.

H_PHI_VAULT_STATUS.PRIVATE_NATIVE_ARRAY_FIELDS: ZERO in ModularBaseConstructionValidator and HectonBlueprintPreviewBatch. Preview batch stores only VaultBufferHandle fields; NativeArray views are local method variables resolved from GlobalDataVault.
H_PHI_VAULT_STATUS.VAULT_LOCKS: ConstructionPreviewWrite, ConstructionPreviewBuild, and ConstructionPreviewMatrices are locked while BuildPreviewMatricesJob owns their pointers and unlocked after job completion or teardown force-completion. ConstructionBuilderOccupancy is locked during PlayerBuilder occupancy hydration and fixed-table lookup, then unlocked before returning.
H_PHI_VAULT_STATUS.COLD_ALLOCATIONS: Editor-only File.ReadAllBytes for module_bounds.csv; fault-path byte[] for DumpTelemetry. Neither is gameplay validation hot path.

POINTER_ALIASING_AND_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH.CURRENT_PLAYERBUILDER_PATH: Uses scalar validator call for immediate ghost feedback. No arbitrary JobHandle.Complete was introduced.
POINTER_ALIASING_AND_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH.LIVE_OCCUPANCY_FALLBACK: PlayerBuilder scans ConstructionManager.SpawnedModules with for-loops only to hydrate the locked ConstructionBuilderOccupancy Vault hash table, then rejects the candidate with TryFindOccupiedCell fixed-table lookup. This is not the final graph-owner export, but it removes the normal-path direct list compare and does not allocate a private NativeMultiHashMap.
POINTER_ALIASING_AND_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH.SIGNAL_LANES: PlayerBuilder pushes ConstructionPreviewSignal and FloraExclusionSignal through SignalBus. Build clunk uses GlobalSignals.Publish(AcousticPingSignal) on the canonical global acoustic lane.

COMPILE_GUARD.ASMDEF_CHANGES: None added by SHINOBU_67. No direct asmdef reference to sibling Runtime assembly was introduced.
COMPILE_GUARD.CORE_TOUCH_CAVEAT: H8Memory BufferID enum was touched earlier for Vault IDs. A later AUP recheck added a narrow HectonVoxelVolume runtime-space SDF facade to remove construction's absolute-float AUP cast. Both edits are compile-wall hostile caveats and are recorded instead of hidden.
COMPILE_GUARD.SDF_CAVEAT: PlayerBuilder still uses Hecton8.Caves.HectonVoxelVolume as same-project SDF adapter because no GlobalRegistry world-sampler lease exists. The adapter now exposes runtime-space sampling so construction no longer casts absolute AUP to float before origin subtraction. This is a controlled caveat, not a new asmdef edge.

AUP_RECHECK.OLD_FAULT: RootAUP + localProbe was reduced to absolute float3 before HectonVoxelVolume.GetSDFDensity.
AUP_RECHECK.FIX: RootAUP + localProbe stays double3 until HectonFloatingOrigin.ToRuntimePosition(double3). Runtime-space Vector3 is then sampled by TrySampleRuntimeSdfDensity.
AUP_RECHECK.RESULT: No absolute float AUP handoff remains in the SHINOBU_67 construction SDF probe path.

BLACKBOX_HASH_RECHECK.OLD_FAULT: Live occupancy and voxel SDF flags were applied after the base validation result hash was computed.
BLACKBOX_HASH_RECHECK.FIX: ApplyFailureFlags refreshes FailureFlags, IsValid, StructuralWarning, MinSdfDistance, OccupiedCellHash, and ResultHash in one validator-owned helper.
BLACKBOX_HASH_RECHECK.RESULT: Telemetry ResultHash now represents the final rejection evidence seen by PlayerBuilder.

DEAR_LIE_CONFIRMATION.FAKE: Modules are treated as strict-grid AABBs, not mesh/poly intersections. Terrain rejection is distance sampling, not collider broadphase.
DEAR_LIE_CONFIRMATION.BEFORE: Collider broadphase OverlapBox over terrain/vehicle/debris/base layers: O(C) over broadphase candidates, vulnerable to non-collider mountains.
DEAR_LIE_CONFIRMATION.AFTER: Vault fixed-table grid hash lookup O(1) after zero-allocation module hydration plus SDF probes O(P), P in [1,9] from GlobalQualityWeight. No Physics.OverlapBox.
DEAR_LIE_CONFIRMATION.VISUAL_FAKE_STATUS: ConstructionPreviewSignal plus HectonBlueprintPreviewBatch provides an unmanaged instanced AABB fallback. Final BRG module-hash rendering remains external render-owner work. Editor gizmo provides diagnostic visual fake for rejection boxes.
